_meta.provenance: MIXED. sectionProxy and authoredAdditions are REAL, verbatim from SNACK-LIBRARY.md §2.1 and §2.2. The id slugs are this fixture's encoding.
notes: Snack 2 has two sources (ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3): book recipes whose section is in the 'in' list, and authored entries shaped like Snack 1 entries.

The authored additions carry no page and no season (SNACK-LIBRARY.md §3). They also carry no 'family', so the VAR-04 no-consecutive-family rule has nothing to act on in this slot - see CRITERIA-MAP.md gap G-08.
SNACK-LIBRARY.md §2.2 says 'a dozen' and lists 12. Confirmed: 12 entries below.

sectionProxy._note: REAL. SNACK-LIBRARY.md §2.1. Kid-friendly is approximated by section, not hand-tagged. GEN-06.
sectionProxy._contradiction: Section 21 'Bhakri, Roti and Cutlets' is in the Snack 2 'in' list, yet roti is also a main-meal composition role (REQUIREMENTS.md §3.3, 'rice or roti'). The two synthetic roti records in recipes.book.SYNTHETIC.json therefore carry slots ['main'] only, which contradicts the section proxy. See CRITERIA-MAP.md gap G-05.
sectionProxy._unlisted: Sections 1, 3, 5-9, 12-16, 22, 27, 29 and 30 appear in neither list. The documents never enumerate all 30 headings, so whether an unlisted section is in or out of Snack 2 is undefined. See CRITERIA-MAP.md gap G-06.

derivedPool._note: The Snack 2 pool against recipes.book.SYNTHETIC.json: book records whose section is in sectionProxy.in AND whose slots include 'snack2', plus all 12 authored additions.

derivedPool._windowVsPool: VAR-05 sets the Snack 2 window at 14 days against a pool of 21 in this fixture. That is survivable. Against a pool of 14 or fewer it is not, and the GEN-08 fallback fires every day - which is why the authored additions matter to the arithmetic, not just the nutrition.
